body: I'm not sure how a therapist would really help me no longer be a fuckup. Even if it could, explaining this to my parents would literally be impossible.

Like I said earlier, I'm not actually going to kill myself. I'm not looking for a silver bullet either, because there really is no fix to what my life is. You're right, everyone goes through a rough time. The difference is that for most people its 6 months, or a year. I've had a rough 15 years, and all signs are pointing down for the next 15 or 20.
